Thanks for the note, Eli — glad to hear the test went well. Before I loop in a promo approval, can you confirm whether the additional run is for the same org (same billing/account) or a separate team creating parallel accounts? We’ve seen a few cases where customers spin up multiple eval orgs to extend trials and we need to validate to comply with our promo policy.

If it’s the same org, please share the HubSpot pipeline/deal ID and the expected timeline for purchase. If there are separate orgs or duplicate signups, we’ll need product logs to verify (and we may require a manager approval).

Soojin / Ben / Karthik — forwarding Eli’s thread. I pulled the account activity and there are three distinct signup fingerprints over the last 45 days (same company domain but different workspace IDs, correlated IP ranges show some overlap). This pattern matches other cases where teams create parallel pilots to extend promo coverage.

Suggested next steps:
- Hold additional credit grant until ops verifies there is a legitimate conversion timeline (signed PO or clear procurement cadence).
- Ask Orbital to consolidate pilots under a single workspace or provide justification for separate workstreams.
- If procurement can provide an expected invoice/PO date within 30 days, consider a small one-off credit grant (max 25k) with a written agreement.

Ben — can you own the customer comms? Karthik — can you run a quick fraud-pattern check (signups/IPs/behavior) and flag anomalies? I’m inclined to deny the full 50k until we see consolidation or PO.

Marissa Cole

Hi Eli — thanks for sharing details and the usage export. I’m Ben on the accounts team and will coordinate here. We ran a preliminary check and found multiple workspace IDs tied to the orbitalai.com domain that are consuming promo credits in close succession. To move forward we need one of the following: 

1) Consolidate the evaluation into your primary workspace (preferred) and confirm which workspace will continue.
2) Provide a signed PO or a firm invoice date within 30 days for the additional 50k credits.

As a gesture, if OrbitalAI can confirm consolidation or provide the PO within 7 business days we’ll issue a temporary 20k credit grant to cover the immediate run. Otherwise we’ll need to decline the supplemental 50k request to preserve promo integrity.

Please reply with which option you’ll take and attach any procurement docs (you can send to account-payments@redwood.ai). Once we have that I’ll open the promo allocation ticket.

Regards,
